findings.title: Auth: API Key in Header, Not Query Param
findings.detail: Docs say query param, actual requires X-API-Key header

findings.title: Auth: access_token, Not token
findings.detail: Response field is 'access_token' not 'token'. Expires in 900s (15 min) not 86400 (24h). Includes refresh_token.

findings.title: Pagination: Offset-Based, Not Page-Based
findings.detail: 'page' parameter silently ignored. Must use 'offset' and 'limit'. Max limit=50 not 200.

findings.title: Total Count Inaccurate
findings.detail: Listings total=3684 but actual=3800. Rentals total=1406 actual=1450. Projects total=427 actual=440.

findings.title: Filters Silently Ignored
findings.detail: min_price, max_price, furnishing filters have no effect. Only locality, bhk, property_type work.

findings.title: Timestamps: IST, Not UTC
findings.detail: Server uses +05:30 IST. Listings lack timezone suffix. Rentals use Z suffix. Inconsistent.

findings.title: Undocumented: /v1/localities
findings.detail: Returns locality list with listing counts. Not documented.

findings.title: Rental Schema: super_builtup_area vs super_built_up_area
findings.detail: Rentals use 'super_builtup_area', listings use 'super_built_up_area'. Different field names.

findings.title: Project Prices: Mixed Units
findings.detail: price_min and price_max use mixed lakhs/crores. 73% of projects have price_min > price_max.

findings.title: Fake Listings: Impossibly Low Prices
findings.detail: 7 listings have prices ₹7,910-₹17,510 (1000x below median). Likely wrong units or test data.

findings.title: Corrupt Listings: Structural Violations
findings.detail: 21 listings have negative prices, areas, or floors exceeding total building floors.
